=== adonisjs + adonisjs-ddev + mariadb
framework: adonisjs
recipes:
  - adonisjs-ddev (env)
  - mariadb (db)
  - adonisjs (framework)
steps:
  $ ddev config --project-type=generic --webserver-type=generic --docroot='' --nodejs-version=24 --database=mariadb:11.8
  $ mkdir -p .ddev/mysql && cp .keel/mariadb/my.cnf .ddev/mysql/keel-mariadb.cnf
  $ ddev restart
  $ bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; }; rm -rf keeltmp && npm init adonisjs@latest -y -- keeltmp --kit=api --pkg=npm && cp -a keeltmp/. . && rm -rf keeltmp && test -f package.json && npm pkg set name="$(basename "$PWD" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]")"'
  $ ddev start
  $ ddev restart
files:
  .ddev/config.adonisjs.yaml sha256:f91163771fe1a62d5de91713f22ce6facb28e952df94797c8f56271b85f2659d
  .ddev/config.db.yaml sha256:cbd875cad3e9c5c45c16ed3326b4a5914d88e3e9b1bf92397b67178a886a8de5
  .keel/mariadb/my.cnf sha256:a30df33fff76786eae7f1031e5e305b6c93c79d5cc1abe5c00b2aa716f3bedaa
patches:
hooks:
smoke:
  $ bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; }; node ace list >/dev/null'

=== adonisjs + adonisjs-ddev + mongo
framework: adonisjs
recipes:
  - adonisjs-ddev (env)
  - mongo (db)
  - adonisjs (framework)
steps:
  $ ddev config --project-type=generic --webserver-type=generic --docroot='' --nodejs-version=24
  $ ddev restart
  $ ddev exec -s mongo mongosh --quiet --eval 'try { rs.status().ok } catch (e) { rs.initiate() }'
  $ bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; }; rm -rf keeltmp && npm init adonisjs@latest -y -- keeltmp --kit=api --pkg=npm && cp -a keeltmp/. . && rm -rf keeltmp && test -f package.json && npm pkg set name="$(basename "$PWD" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]")"'
  $ ddev start
  $ ddev restart
files:
  .ddev/config.adonisjs.yaml sha256:f91163771fe1a62d5de91713f22ce6facb28e952df94797c8f56271b85f2659d
  .ddev/config.db.yaml sha256:76e446cc08dd1bb8ace92032554a36ce32eca4005c0f73d24e06b4e731718c3a
  .ddev/docker-compose.mongo.yaml sha256:30266ade763e0d4697623e308417fa16ad5ae96b25426ccd8b7129a2e0f26963
  .keel/mongodb/mongod.conf sha256:e5cd2fa1f622aa4741bcaba901389cb64000529b3c2e61329f7eb9c334ced1ae
  MONGODB.md sha256:0c0d064ef2336ac2ce34c2b9fc0b06a60a95ee6e3241c0f908d03b515a3154d0
  docker-compose.mongo.yml sha256:445049d25680b5e9b093c9eda1210372b4079105cae86ccca8b76d1bea35fa54
patches:
hooks:
smoke:
  $ bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; }; node ace list >/dev/null'

=== adonisjs + adonisjs-docker + mariadb
framework: adonisjs
recipes:
  - adonisjs-docker (env)
  - mariadb (db)
  - adonisjs (framework)
steps:
  $ bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; }; rm -rf keeltmp && npm init adonisjs@latest -y -- keeltmp --kit=api --pkg=npm && cp -a keeltmp/. . && rm -rf keeltmp && test -f package.json && npm pkg set name="$(basename "$PWD" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]")"'
  $ docker compose up -d --build
  $ docker compose restart
files:
  .dockerignore sha256:473374d3add71fc35ec71bbd300d8a7f4c9a9439d22626ce1265d4b3c416dcc9

=== adonisjs + adonisjs-docker + mongo
framework: adonisjs
recipes:
  - adonisjs-docker (env)
  - mongo (db)
  - adonisjs (framework)
steps:
  $ docker compose -f docker-compose.mongo.yml up -d --wait
  $ docker compose -f docker-compose.mongo.yml exec -T mongo mongosh --quiet --eval 'try { rs.status().ok } catch (e) { rs.initiate() }'
  $ bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; }; rm -rf keeltmp && npm init adonisjs@latest -y -- keeltmp --kit=api --pkg=npm && cp -a keeltmp/. . && rm -rf keeltmp && test -f package.json && npm pkg set name="$(basename "$PWD" | tr "[:upper:]" "[:lower:]")"'
  $ docker compose up -d --build
  $ docker compose restart
files:
  .dockerignore sha256:473374d3add71fc35ec71bbd300d8a7f4c9a9439d22626ce1265d4b3c416dcc9
  .env sha256:1f69eeadd59bc7e0f48ecbafffe32b76077eff0f2d64bfa43edb3a67f516b7f8
  .keel/mongodb/mongod.conf sha256:e5cd2fa1f622aa4741bcaba901389cb64000529b3c2e61329f7eb9c334ced1ae
  Dockerfile sha256:58745fba0ac0b42fb412b0cdb79447de15b3e9d8e1a1fd4d7425b12770eb4f31
  MONGODB.md sha256:0c0d064ef2336ac2ce34c2b9fc0b06a60a95ee6e3241c0f908d03b515a3154d0
  compose.yaml sha256:2b3cca95bd2289bab26945b1fb77495bcf199eb6ffc1d4a7296ab47f6e1c6f55
  docker-compose.mongo.yml sha256:445049d25680b5e9b093c9eda1210372b4079105cae86ccca8b76d1bea35fa54
patches:
hooks:
smoke:
  $ docker compose ps
  $ bash -lc 'export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm"; [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && { . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; nvm use 24 >/dev/null 2>&1; }; node ace list >/dev/null'

=== laravel + ddev + mysql
framework: laravel
recipes:
  - ddev (env)
  - mysql (db)
  - laravel (framework)
  - mysql-laravel (config)
steps:
  $ ddev config --project-type=laravel --docroot=public --database=mysql:8.4
  $ ddev start
  $ mkdir -p .ddev/mysql && cp .keel/mysql/my.cnf .ddev/mysql/keel-mysql.cnf
  $ ddev restart
  $ ddev exec 'rm -rf keeltmp && composer create-project laravel/laravel keeltmp && cp -a keeltmp/. . && rm -rf keeltmp'
  $ ddev start
  $ ddev exec php artisan key:generate --force
  $ ddev exec php artisan migrate --force
  $ ddev exec php artisan storage:link

  .env: DB_DATABASE=db (from mysql-laravel)
  .env: DB_HOST=db (from mysql-laravel)
  .env: DB_PASSWORD=db (from mysql-laravel)
  .env: DB_PORT=3306 (from mysql-laravel)
  .env: DB_USERNAME=db (from mysql-laravel)
hooks:
  post_build: ddev start (from laravel)
smoke:
  $ ddev describe
  $ ddev exec php artisan --version

=== laravel + sail + mysql
framework: laravel
recipes:

  - sail (env)

=== magento + magento-ddev + mariadb
framework: magento
recipes:
  - magento-ddev (env)
  - mariadb (db)
  - magento (framework)
steps:
  $ ddev config --project-type=magento2 --docroot=pub --upload-dirs=media --disable-settings-management --php-version=8.3 --database=mariadb:11.8
  $ ddev add-on get ddev/ddev-opensearch
  $ ddev add-on get ddev/ddev-redis
  $ ddev start
  $ mkdir -p .ddev/mysql && cp .keel/mariadb/my.cnf .ddev/mysql/keel-mariadb.cnf
  $ ddev restart
  $ ddev exec 'rm -rf keeltmp && composer create-project --repository https://repo.magento.com/ magento/project-community-edition keeltmp && cp -a keeltmp/. . && rm -rf keeltmp'
  $ ddev start
  $ ddev exec rm -f app/etc/env.php
  $ ddev magento setup:install --base-url="https://<project>.ddev.site/" --cleanup-database --db-host=db --db-name=db --db-user=db --db-password=db --search-engine=opensearch --opensearch-host=opensearch --opensearch-port=9200 --opensearch-index-prefix=magento --opensearch-timeout=15 --session-save=redis --session-save-redis-host=redis --session-save-redis-port=6379 --session-save-redis-db=2 --cache-backend=redis --cache-backend-redis-server=redis --cache-backend-redis-port=6379 --cache-backend-redis-db=0 --page-cache=redis --page-cache-redis-server=redis --page-cache-redis-port=6379 --page-cache-redis-db=1 --admin-firstname=Magento --admin-lastname=User --admin-email=admin@example.com --admin-user=admin --admin-password=Password123 --language=en_GB --currency=GBP --timezone=Europe/London --use-rewrites=1
  $ ddev magento deploy:mode:set developer
  $ ddev magento module:disable Magento_AdminAdobeImsTwoFactorAuth Magento_TwoFactorAuth || true
  $ ddev config --disable-settings-management=false
  $ ddev magento setup:config:set --backend-frontname=admin --no-interaction
  $ ddev magento setup:upgrade
  $ ddev magento indexer:set-mode schedule
  $ ddev magento indexer:reindex
  $ ddev magento cache:flush
files:
  .ddev/config.db.yaml sha256:cbd875cad3e9c5c45c16ed3326b4a5914d88e3e9b1bf92397b67178a886a8de5

  .gitignore sha256:e8666b4b8c3cede903dfbcc23425a35ca4765c222ef9948dbb5536e57498c5a4
  .keel/mariadb/my.cnf sha256:a30df33fff76786eae7f1031e5e305b6c93c79d5cc1abe5c00b2aa716f3bedaa

hooks:
smoke:
  $ ddev describe
  $ ddev magento setup:db:status

=== woocommerce + woocommerce-ddev + mariadb
framework: woocommerce
recipes:
  - woocommerce-ddev (env)
  - mariadb (db)
  - woocommerce (framework)
steps:
  $ ddev config --project-type=wordpress --php-version=8.3 --database=mariadb:11.8

  $ ddev wp config create --dbname=db --dbuser=db --dbpass=db --dbhost=db --force
  $ ddev wp core install --url=https://<project>.ddev.site --title="<project>" --admin_user=admin --admin_password=admin --admin_email=admin@example.com --skip-email
  $ ddev wp plugin install woocommerce --activate
  $ ddev wp theme install storefront --activate
  $ ddev restart

=== woocommerce-bedrock + woocommerce-docker + mariadb
framework: woocommerce-bedrock
recipes:
  - wordpress-php-fpm (config)
  - woocommerce-docker (env)
  - mariadb (db)
  - woocommerce-bedrock (framework)
steps:
  $ docker compose build php && docker compose run --rm -T --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e COMPOSER_HOME=/tmp -e HOME=/tmp php sh -c 'composer create-project roots/bedrock /tmp/b && cp -a /tmp/b/. /var/www/html/ && rm -rf /tmp/b'
  $ docker compose up -d --build
  $ docker compose exec -T --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e COMPOSER_HOME=/tmp -e HOME=/tmp php sh -c 'printf "DB_NAME=db\nDB_USER=db\nDB_PASSWORD=db\nDB_HOST=db\nWP_ENV=development\nWP_HOME=http://localhost:8080\nWP_SITEURL=http://localhost:8080/wp\n" > .env'
  $ docker compose exec -T --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e COMPOSER_HOME=/tmp -e HOME=/tmp php composer require wp-plugin/woocommerce wp-theme/storefront
  $ docker compose run --rm -T --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp php wp core install --url=http://localhost:8080 --title="<project>" --admin_user=admin --admin_password=admin --admin_email=admin@example.com --skip-email
  $ docker compose run --rm -T --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp php wp plugin activate woocommerce
  $ docker compose run --rm -T --user "$(id -u):$(id -g)" -e HOME=/tmp php wp theme activate storefront
  $ docker compose restart
